name: Desk Standup Stretch
tips: Stand clear of the chair; feet hip-width and soft knees
Interlace fingers and reach overhead; lengthen through both sides of the ribs
Open the chest slightly without overarching the lower back
Hold 5–10 seconds, then release arms and roll the shoulders back
camera_cues: full body or three-quarter; eye level for ergonomics content
side or slight three-quarter to show arm reach and posture line
clean office backdrop; leave negative space above the hands
